plugin.title: b3l0w Audio
plugin.description: Switch audio outputs and inputs, per-device volume and mute, Bluetooth codec selection and battery, from the bar or the panel.

show_label.label: Show label
show_label.desc: Show the volume percentage next to the bar icon.

show_percentage.label: Show percentage
show_percentage.desc: Percentage comes from the device that is currently the default output.

panel_mode.label: Panel mode
panel_mode.desc: Compact attaches the panel to the bar; float opens a larger centered panel.

animations.label: Animations
animations.desc: Fade the device rows when switching between outputs and inputs.

density.label: Density
density.desc: Row height and how many devices fit on one page.

refresh_seconds.label: Fallback refresh (s)
refresh_seconds.desc: Changes arrive from pactl subscribe; this interval only covers a dead event stream.

volume_step.label: Scroll step (%)
volume_step.desc: How much the mouse wheel over the bar icon changes the default output volume.

notify_on_switch.label: Notify on switch
notify_on_switch.desc: Show a notification when the default output, input or codec changes.

show_battery.label: Bluetooth battery
show_battery.desc: Show the battery percentage of Bluetooth devices that report it.

settings.settings.layout_mode.label: Layout
settings.settings.layout_mode.desc: Automatic: the host measures the panel and the content fits it. Fixed: the plugin asks for an explicit width.

panel.title: Audio
panel.mute_all_tip: Mute every output and input at once
panel.cycle_tip: Switch to the next device of this list
panel.move_here_tip: Move every playing stream to this output
panel.hint: Right click the icon: next output · wheel: volume
panel.backend_pactl: Running on pactl only: wpctl was not found
panel.no_streams: No application is playing right now
panel.no_streams_hint: Streams appear here as soon as something sends audio to a sink
panel.bt_none_hint: Codec selection appears when a headset is connected
panel.pin_tip: Pin this output so WirePlumber keeps it when a Bluetooth device connects
panel.bt_no_codec: The connected device exposes no A2DP profiles
panel.profile_hint: A profile sets the stream role and the sample rate
panel.filters_empty: WirePlumber exposes no filter module here
panel.filters_live_empty: No filter node in the graph

widget.hint: Left click: panel · right click: next output · wheel: volume

service.nothing_to_move: Every stream is already on this output
service.only_one: Only one device in this list

error.unknown_codec: That codec is not available on this card
error.unknown_profile: That profile is not available on this card
error.needs_pactl: Changing profiles and codecs needs pactl (wpctl set-profile takes a profile index, not a name)
error.no_channels: That device does not publish a volume per channel
error.unknown_channel: That channel does not exist on this device
error.unknown_module: That filter module does not exist
error.no_fallback: There is no other output device: changing the codec would leave the audio nowhere

settings.layout_mode.label: Layout
settings.layout_mode.desc: Automatic: the host measures the panel and the content fits it. Fixed: the plugin asks for an explicit width.
settings.default_profile.label: Default audio profile
settings.default_profile.desc: Profile applied when you switch output: it sets the stream role and the sample rate asked to the backend.
settings.show_advanced.label: Advanced controls
settings.show_advanced.desc: Show the per-channel volume, the stereo balance and the real latency of each device.
